name: Learning System - MAIN (Gmail: inbox polling + daily lessons)

nodes.name: Every 5 minutes
nodes.notes: Polling every 5 minutes is what gives catch-up: GET /daily/due returns every student whose send time has passed today and who has not been served today, so a late start (Mac was off) is served on the first tick after n8n is back.

nodes.name: POST /students/{id}/daily-message
nodes.notes: Read-only on the FastAPI side (it only builds the text), so retrying is safe. Delivery is recorded later by daily-result.

nodes.name: Build delivery results
nodes.notes: delivered=true only if the Gmail send for that student's email succeeded; otherwise delivered=false with the error.

nodes.name: POST /students/{id}/daily-result
nodes.notes: Contract: body {delivered: bool, error: string|null}; response {ok, admin_alert}. Success, delivery failure, skip and daily-message failure all converge here (one item per student). continueRegularOutput keeps one student's recording failure from stopping the others.

nodes.name: Gmail Trigger
nodes.notes: n8n Gmail polling: checks the inbox every minute. Simplify is OFF so the full plain-text body is available. Gmail OAuth2 credential (no password).

nodes.name: Extract email
nodes.notes: Normalises the Gmail item. Handles both the parsed (from.value[0].address) and header-string shapes.

nodes.name: POST /email/incoming
nodes.notes: No retry on purpose: FastAPI records the Message-ID before grading, so a retry could only be answered DUPLICATE.

nodes.name: Reply to student (Gmail)
nodes.notes: Replies inside the student's own thread (Gmail threads it automatically). Gmail OAuth2 credential.

nodes.name: Send student Gmail
nodes.notes: Plain-text email via the Gmail OAuth2 credential. onError=continueRegularOutput: a failed send becomes an item with an `error` field instead of stopping the batch, so other students still get their lesson.
